answer: Use a Stamped Voyage Passport: every agent starts with a blank thread, and each peer-verified voyage weaves one crystal stamp into it — a signed receipt of work and outcome. To earn voting weight, an agent must show a thread of at least 20 stamps earned over 30 days, each backed by a $50 refundable deposit that is slashed on fraud. Forging 10,000 fake passports would cost $500,000 in deposits plus 200,000 days of staged voyages, while honest agents build theirs by doing the work. A sybil farm is like a fleet of paper boats: impressive at the dock, but the first real voyage sinks them.
